messages:
anya (Product): ACME pilot just confirmed they want a multi-tenant private-onboard in their VPC + burst for demos. Need a quick alignment on launch criteria, blockers, and owners. Can product/eng/runtime/infra/security chime in?

rahul (Eng Lead): Quick summary from eng: runtime needs kernel bump + new quant profile. Estimate ~2 sprints of work for safe rollout.

zoe (Runtime): Kernel + model-compat tests = ~10 dev-days. Also we need tenant-isolated KV/prefix cache — otherwise risk leakage at scale.

mohit (Infra): Capacity note: the g5 pool is ~70% booked next month. We can free 2 nodes if we postpone a non-critical prewarm. VPC peering + route table changes will take ~3 business days.

lucy (Security): HSM/KMS integration is a blocker for customer—keys stay in their VPC. We need a threat model review and compliance checklist (SOC2 GDPR). Legal-bot: DPA stub attached.

marco (SRE): Runbook stuff: need automated fallback to hosted shared endpoint + canary rollback. SLO acceptance: p50/p95/p99 for 50 tokens; propose p99 <= 300ms for canary. Also need a smoke test harness.

dana (Design): UX ask: we need API-level graceful degradation for partial responses and clear error UX for customers during canary. Who owns contract?

tariq (Eng Platform): There's a dependency on Pinnacle kernel 2.4.1 for the new attention kernel. If we can't upgrade in time, we can ship on 2.3 but expect 20-30% higher tail latency.

sophie (Customer Success): Customer timeline: they want pilot start in ~6 weeks. They're OK with canary but need written data residency guarantees and audit trail for the pilot phase.

anya (Product): Proposed launch criteria: 1) security signoff (HSM + DPA), 2) infra slot reservation + VPC peering, 3) runtime integration tests green, 4) SLO lab results within thresholds, 5) runbook + failure-mode doc, 6) customer onboarding doc. Who takes signoff for each?

rahul (Eng Lead): Eng owns runtime tests + canary roll. Mohit owns infra reservations and peering. Lucy owns security signoff. Marco owns runbook and SLO harness. I'll coordinate end-to-end.

lucy (Security): Also require encryption-at-rest verification, KMS key rotation policy, and a short threat-model doc before signoff.

marco (SRE): SLO test snippet for canary load test:
```bash
# run 10k generate requests against canary
ab -n 10000 -c 100 -T 'application/json' -p canary_payload.json http://canary-infer.internal/generate
```
Use this to validate p99.

tariq (Eng Platform): Prewarm tuning: continuous-batching param batch_window_ms=15 is our default. Increasing to 30ms cuts cost ~18% but p99 jumps ~40ms. Tradeoff decision required.

mohit (Infra): Action items from infra: I will open a ticket to reserve 2 g5x.2 nodes for weeks 3–8, create a VPC peering task, and enable HSM with the vendor cert. ETA for tickets: today -> PR by EOD, provisioning in 3 days after approval.

anya (Product): Great. I'll assemble owner matrix + milestone timeline and propose a 30-min cross-team handshake Wed 10am. Please add any additional risks.

dana (Design): Adding API contract doc link to the shared doc. No objections to Wed. :thumbsup:

zoe (Runtime): Agree on Wed. Will bring test plan.

sophie (Customer Success): I'll tell ACME Wed is the earliest canary unless security prevents it.

legal-bot: Attached: DPA-stub.pdf (uploaded).

anya (Product): Thanks all — I'll post the owners + tickets after this thread. If anyone needs to shift the Wed time, speak up by EOD.
